title: Automatic GitHub Sync and Deployment Policy
sourceOfTruth: GitHub repository main branch is the authoritative persisted state for Mythos Gates.
nonNegotiables: Every approved development change must be persisted to GitHub.
Temporary runtime, browser, preview, or local working state is never authoritative.
Do not declare an update complete unless the approved change is pushed to GitHub.
Do not expose GitHub credentials to frontend code, GitHub Pages, JSON data, localStorage, asset manifests, or build output.
Do not claim deployment succeeded until GitHub Actions/Pages reports success.

largeFileHandling.rule: Stop and report before pushing extremely large artwork. Recommend Git LFS or external asset storage; never silently delete or over-compress approved art.

commitRules: Group related changes into one logical commit.
Run validation, build, game data validation, asset validation, Visual QA, and mobile responsiveness checks before commit.

statusMeanings.SYNCED: Everything approved is pushed to GitHub.
statusMeanings.CHANGES_PENDING: Development changes exist that have not yet been pushed.
statusMeanings.SYNC_ERROR: Push failed or remote verification failed.
statusMeanings.DEPLOYING: GitHub Actions or Pages deployment is still in progress.

requiredBeforeSync: Run npm run index before validation
Commit data/index.json with every dashboard data change
Reject stale data/index.json via npm run index:check
indexPolicy: data/index.json is dashboard-critical and must include counts plus source file SHA-256 fingerprints. It is regenerated during build and checked before GitHub sync.
